deals.travelWindow: Sat departures Sep 12, 19, 26; Oct 24, 31; Nov 7, 14, 21 cheapest confirmed dates, nonstop American
deals.whyRanked: The cheapest verified fare of the five at $131 RT nonstop; no national park nearby, but the price alone earns the top spot.
deals.soloWhy: Deep Ellum and the Bishop Arts District are compact, walkable pockets with counter-service tacos and live music, though rideshares are needed to bridge the sprawl between them.

highlights: Klyde Warren Park (deck park over the freeway, food trucks)
Deep Ellum street art and live-music clubs
Bishop Arts District boutiques and pie shops
The Sixth Floor Museum at Dealey Plaza
Dallas Arboretum and Botanical Garden
itinerary: Day 1 — Klyde Warren Park, the Sixth Floor Museum, dinner and live music in Deep Ellum.
Day 2 — Dallas Arboretum in the morning, Bishop Arts District for the afternoon and evening.
Day 3 — Cedar Hill State Park for a short lakeside trail before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: DART light rail covers DFW-to-downtown and the main museum district, but a rideshare or rental car is worth it for Bishop Arts and the arboretum.
guide.stayArea: Deep Ellum or downtown — walkable to the rail line and nightlife.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 20-23, 25, 27-31 cheapest confirmed dates, nonstop on Delta, JetBlue, or Southwest
deals.whyRanked: $137 RT nonstop ties for the cheapest fare of the five, and Mammoth Cave National Park — the world's longest known cave system — is a 90-minute drive north.
deals.soloWhy: Broadway's honky-tonks and songwriter rounds are built for showing up alone, and downtown, the Gulch, and Music Row are all walkable without a car.

highlights: Broadway honky-tonks and live music
Ryman Auditorium tour
Country Music Hall of Fame
Centennial Park's full-scale Parthenon replica
Mammoth Cave National Park guided cave tour
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk Broadway's honky-tonks, Ryman Auditorium tour, dinner in the Gulch.
Day 2 — Country Music Hall of Fame, Centennial Park and the Parthenon, songwriter round at the Bluebird Cafe at night.
Day 3 — Drive to Mammoth Cave for a ranger-led cave tour before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown, the Gulch, and Music Row are walkable; a rental car is needed for the 90-minute drive to Mammoth Cave.
guide.stayArea: The Gulch or downtown — walkable to Broadway and the honky-tonks.

deals.travelWindow: Nov 4-5, 11-12, 18-20 cheapest confirmed dates, nonstop on Delta or JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: Ties Nashville at $137 RT nonstop, and Savannah's walkable historic squares plus Cumberland Island National Seashore's wild beaches 90 minutes south give it the edge for a solo trip.
deals.soloWhy: The historic district's squares and River Street are flat, walkable, and lined with counter-seating cafes, making solo dining and evening strolls effortless.

highlights: Forsyth Park and its fountain
River Street and the historic cotton warehouses
Self-guided walking tour of the historic squares
Bonaventure Cemetery
Cumberland Island National Seashore day trip (ferry from St. Marys)
itinerary: Day 1 — Walk the historic squares from Forsyth Park to River Street, dinner along the riverfront.
Day 2 — Bonaventure Cemetery in the morning, City Market shops and a ghost tour at night.
Day 3 — Drive to St. Marys for the ferry to Cumberland Island's wild beaches and wild horses before an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The historic district is entirely walkable; a rental car is needed for Tybee Island or the Cumberland Island ferry dock.
guide.stayArea: The Historic District — walkable to every square, River Street, and City Market.
food: The Grey (in a converted Greyhound station)

deals.travelWindow: Aug 29 - Sep 2 cheapest confirmed dates on Frontier; fares run into fall on United, Delta, and Southwest
deals.whyRanked: A fresh $152 RT nonstop Frontier fare, still the best price-to-park ratio of the five: Rocky Mountain National Park is 90 minutes away via Estes Park.
deals.soloWhy: The A Line train runs straight from DEN into downtown, the RiNo Art District and Union Station area are walkable, and Confluence Park draws a steady crowd for an easy solo paddle or run.

highlights: RiNo Art District murals and breweries
Union Station's restaurants and Great Hall
Confluence Park for kayaking or a riverside walk
16th Street Mall for an easy downtown stroll
Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor
itinerary: Day 1 — Union Station and the 16th Street Mall, dinner and a brewery crawl in RiNo.
Day 2 — Confluence Park in the morning for a paddle or run, LoDo galleries and shops in the afternoon.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Rocky Mountain NP: the Bear Lake corridor for an easy alpine hike, back to Denver for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The A Line train covers the airport-to-downtown hop and RiNo/Union Station are walkable; a rental car is needed for the national park.
guide.stayArea: RiNo or Union Station area — walkable, close to breweries and the train.

deals.travelWindow: Oct - early Dec cheapest confirmed window, nonstop American (basic economy $202, regular economy $312)
deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the five at $202 RT basic economy, but Pinnacles National Park's condor-filled crags are 90 minutes south and the Bay Area's food scene rewards the splurge.
deals.soloWhy: VTA light rail and a walkable downtown core make it easy without a car for a day or two, and Santana Row's counter-seating restaurants suit solo dining.

highlights: Santana Row shopping and dining district
Japantown — one of the last three historic Japantowns in the US
Winchester Mystery House
Alum Rock Park's canyon trails
Pinnacles National Park day trip for condor viewing
itinerary: Day 1 — Winchester Mystery House tour, dinner and shopping at Santana Row.
Day 2 — Japantown for mochi and ramen, Alum Rock Park for an afternoon canyon hike.
Day 3 — Drive to Pinnacles National Park for the talus caves and a chance at spotting California condors, back for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: VTA light rail covers downtown and Santana Row; a rental car is essential for Pinnacles and Henry Coe.
guide.stayArea: Downtown San Jose or Santana Row — walkable, close to transit and restaurants.
food: Japantown's Shuei-Do Manju Shop and ramen counters
